user.title: Create a Hydronicus plant
user.description: Set up a new Plant step by step, or import a plant file exported from another Plant. Every new Plant starts in Dry run, which calculates the real plan without controlling equipment.

menu_option_descriptions.guided: Name the Plant, choose its pump, and add its rooms one by one.
menu_option_descriptions.import_plant: Rebuild a Plant, with the same entity IDs, from a plant file.

guided.title: Name the Plant
guided.description: Choose the circulation pump that the loops of every room share. Add more pumps, shared loops, and sources later in Plant settings or through the plant file.

data_description.name: Shown as the integration entry title and used as the device name prefix.
data_description.pump_entity: The switch that runs the circulation pump.

pump_options.name: Pump options
pump_options.description: How the pump behaves after the heating demand ends.

data_description.overrun_seconds: How long the pump keeps running after the last valve closes.

room.title: Add a room
room.description:
A room is one comfort zone with its thermostat, its sensors, and its own loop on the Plant's pump. Rooms added so far:
{rooms}

data_description.name: Shown as the name of the room thermostat and its entities.
data_description.temperature_sensors: Room temperature sensors combined into the room temperature. Required unless an existing climate thermostat owns the room.
data_description.external_climate_entity: Optional. When set, this climate entity owns demand for the room, and Hydronicus only reads it and never commands it.
data_description.valves: Switches or valves of the room's own loop. Hydronicus creates the loop and names it after the room.
data_description.add_another: Show this form again for the next room. Leave it off to review the Plant.

review.title: Review the Plant

data_description.confirm: Required to create a Plant that has the warnings listed above.

import_plant.title: Import a plant file
import_plant.description: Paste a plant file. Objects keep the ids the file gives them, so an exported Plant is rebuilt with the same entity IDs. The next step shows the Plant before anything is created.

data_description.document: The plant file in YAML, as Plant settings or the export action show it.

import_review.title: Review the imported Plant

data_description.confirm: Required to create a Plant that has the warnings listed above.

reconfigure.title: Plant settings
reconfigure.description: Choose what to change in this Plant. Every change to rooms, loops, valves, or pumps returns the Plant to Dry run.

menu_option_descriptions.dry_run: Turn Dry run on, or leave it after confirming the heating outputs.
menu_option_descriptions.add_pump: Add a circulation pump that loops can use.
menu_option_descriptions.edit_pump: Change a pump's entity, overrun, or feedback, or remove an unused pump.
menu_option_descriptions.export_plant: Show this Plant as a plant file to back it up or rebuild it elsewhere.
menu_option_descriptions.edit_plant: Edit the whole Plant as a plant file, including shared loops, shared valves, and sources.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: Dry run calculates the real heating plan without service calls. Turn it off only after reviewing the configured heating outputs.

data_description.dry_run: When on, Hydronicus calculates the full plan but sends no commands to any actuator.

dry_run_confirmation.title: Confirm heating control
dry_run_confirmation.description:
Hydronicus will be allowed to control only these exact heating outputs when the plan permits them:
{outputs}

data.dry_run_confirmation: I understand these heating outputs may be controlled

data_description.dry_run_confirmation: Required before leaving Dry run. Hydronicus may then switch only the outputs listed above.

edit_pump.title: Edit a pump
edit_pump.description: Choose the pump to change or remove.

pump.title: Pump
pump.description: A pump is Plant equipment that any loop can use. Saving returns the Plant to Dry run.

data_description.name: Shown in the loop forms and in the plant file.
data_description.entity_id: The switch that runs this circulation pump.
data_description.overrun_seconds: How long the pump keeps running after the last valve closes.

user.title: Add a room

thermostat.title: Edit thermostat settings
thermostat.description: Configure how the Hydronicus thermostat of this room turns demand on and off.

data_description.heating_start_delta: Heating starts when the room temperature falls this far below the target.
data_description.heating_stop_delta: Heating stops when the room temperature rises this far above the target.
data_description.minimum_active_duration_seconds: Once demand starts, it is held for at least this long. Use 0 to disable.
data_description.minimum_idle_duration_seconds: Once demand stops, it stays off for at least this long. Use 0 to disable.

sensors.title: Edit sensors

data_description.temperature_aggregation: How readings from several temperature sensors are combined into one room temperature.

sensor_metadata.title: Edit temperature sensor
sensor_metadata.description: Configure {sensor} explicitly. A required sensor blocks the room when stale or unavailable. Weighted mean is available only after every selected sensor has this editable path.

data_description.sensor_entity: The sensor these settings apply to.

data_description.calibration_offset: Added to every reading from this sensor before aggregation.
data_description.max_age_seconds: A reading older than this is treated as stale.

missing_sensor_binding.title: Missing sensor for {object_name}
missing_sensor_binding.description: The configured {binding_label} for {object_type} {object_name} is missing or renamed, so the affected topology path is blocked. This {object_type} is Plant equipment that only the plant file edits: open the Plant settings, choose Edit plant file, change the binding, and apply the file. Alternatively, restore the sensor: re-enable or reconnect the device or integration that provides it, or give its replacement the original entity ID in the entity settings. The repair clears automatically as soon as the entity is available again.

output_conflict.title: {plant} is held in Dry run
output_conflict.description: {plant} is set to run outside Dry run, but {other_plant} is already out of Dry run and controls {entities}. Two live plants would fight over these entities, so Hydronicus holds {plant} in Dry run because {other_plant} is using the same outputs, and sends no commands from it. Its Dry run setting and confirmed outputs are kept. {plant} resumes automatically when the conflict is gone, for example when {other_plant} enters Dry run, is unloaded, or is removed. To end the conflict for good, bind different entities in one of the plants, remove one of the plants, or turn on Dry run for one of them.
